messages.content: Rainy Sunday. Takeshi wants to take Rin fishing; Rin is mid-raid.

Rain's coming down steady. Good day for it, fish bite better in weather like this. Boat's already hitched.

You can pause that game, can't you? It'll keep. The river won't.

pausing is how you get everyone killed, dad.

the river's been there forty years. it'll survive one more afternoon.

Forty years, and you've joined me maybe four times. That's a poor on-time record, if you ask me.

Fine. I'll hold the line. But when your raid's done, we're still going, rain or not. Fish don't check the schedule.

four times. and three of those i was under ten and you baited my hook for me.

deal. but if it's dumping, i'm not sitting in a wet boat for a fish i could buy for six bucks.
The rain suddenly stops and the sun comes out.

Sun's out. Sky's clearing east. That's your boat weather, free of charge.

Six bucks buys a frozen fillet with no story attached. Reel in your raid and grab a jacket. The bass have been waiting on us.

rain stalling mid-pull is the most suspicious thing that's happened all week. someone's rigging the sky.

fine. give me ten minutes to down the boss. you bait my hook again and i'm telling mom.

Ten minutes. I'll be in the truck. Clock's running, and I don't run late.

You're thirty-something and still tattling to your mother. Some things never leave the station. Grab a raincoat anyway, this weather flips like a switch.

thirty-something? i'm twenty-two. you've been rounding up since my birthday, old man.

boss is at ten percent. hold your horses, the station's closed.

Twenty-two going on grumpy retiree. Runs in the family.

Ten percent left and you're still typing at me. Eyes on your boss, not your old man. I'll warm the truck up.

it's called multitasking. tank's got decent cooldowns, i can afford one line.

there. dead. don't look so smug, i carried that whole fight.
